items.en: A notice opens the line into the notch for a few seconds, like a finished timer
The Claude card in AI usage stays current on Windows with the desktop app's sign-in, no terminal needed
A question from crest-notify too long to show whole is refused, so Allow never approves text you did not see
A broken or hostile calendar feed can no longer stop Crest
A sound of Crest's own when a notice pops up: ten short ones or a file of yours, with Windows' sound off for those apps
The app's own icon on notices from desktop programs like Chrome and Discord, larger on the Notices page
A notice you read in its app, like a WhatsApp message, leaves Crest too
Switching to a smaller tool no longer closes the notch
A Copy button in the Vault's password form
Focus mode is gone: three quick clicks on the notch no longer make it half transparent
A shortcut of its own for any tool, which opens the notch straight on it from anywhere
Paste directly from the Clipboard history into the app you were in, like Win + V. Off by default
Crest's own eyedropper, right on every monitor whatever its scaling, and the system's colour sampler on the Mac
Back up settings, notes, to-dos and the tools' data to a file, and restore them on this PC or another one
Web search from Overview, and Ask with a model on your PC through LM Studio or Ollama, without a key
Panel scale from 80 to 200 percent, and the album cover behind the whole panel in Now Playing
About 160 currencies in the Converter and Calc, the Vietnamese dong among them
Fixes for drags out of the Shelf, an invisible banner window that caught the pointer, and new tracks that started at their end
Six new tools, off until you turn them on in Settings, Tools: Calc, Clocks, Colour, Habits, Prompter and Agents
Break reminders: an eye break every 20 minutes and a longer one every hour of real computer time
Send Shelf files to your phone with a QR code, over your local network only
Translate lyrics offline, and show the translated or romanised line in the closed notch
AI usage shows where each limit is heading and can tell you when one resets
Copy one-time codes from notices, decode chips in the Clipboard and dates typed into new to-dos
Hide Crest from screen sharing, a microphone mute and a list of listening ports in Hardware
More than 150 fixes from a full review on Windows and the Mac, including a crash on wake from standby
Recorder: record sound only from the microphone, the system audio or both, for calls too. Off by default, turn it on in Settings, Tools
Set the brightness of the notch screen from Overview, on external monitors and a laptop screen
AI usage says when a reading is out of date and can renew an expired sign-in in Crest's terminal
A click on a notice opens what it is about: What's new, the recording, AI usage or Now Playing
Choose the app's font in Settings, Themes: sixteen fonts, each shown as itself in the menu
Report a bug from Settings, with your Crest version already filled in
Menus in Settings open upright with the notch on the bottom or a side edge
On a side edge the open panel slides along the edge again, and the resize grips and Done button are in reach
Calendar Join buttons and other links with parameters open the browser again
Light themes: the terminal and the video badges in Capture are readable
Longer translations fit in Overview, Capture, the calendar and Hardware
Arabic: sliders, level bars and the clipboard row scroll the right way
Crest starts on Windows N editions without the Media Feature Pack
Shortcuts recorded on non-US keyboards fire on the key you pressed
Left-handed mouse, a Pictures folder moved by OneDrive and file names with commas now work
Store version: the microphone is recorded
Coloured icons across the app, an option in Settings, Themes, readable on every theme
Timer and clock colours, and five new looks: Flip, Nixie, Ring, LCD and Analog
Answer a coding agent's permission request from the notch, through crest-notify ask
Join online meetings from the calendar and from the notice before an event
Pick the audio output from the volume tile in Overview
Keep awake in Overview, and the Windows power plan in Hardware
Caps Lock and Num Lock in the notch, like the volume
Focus sounds while the timer runs: white, pink and brown noise, rain and waves
Search in Settings
Temperatures and power from HWiNFO or LibreHardwareMonitor when one of them runs
Spectrum and Wave equalizers, a wavy progress bar and a tint from the album art
A Camera tool to check yourself before a call
Find text on any screen with Ctrl+Alt+F
Downloads in progress in the closed notch
Each process's CPU share in percent in Hardware
Windows notices open their app on a click, and leave the notification centre when deleted
Eight new themes: Catppuccin Mocha and Latte, Nord, Rosé Pine and Dawn, Gruvbox Dark, Solarized Light and Everforest
A click or a hover on a part of the closed notch opens its tool
Resize the closed notch, capsule or line on the notch itself, from Settings, Display
A notice in the closed notch for a new version and what it changed
The converter opens on the units and currencies used last
The weather keeps the last forecast when the service is down
Security and reliability fixes for the vault, plugins, Ask, Discord and Crest's windows
A month in the Calendar, with a dot for each calendar on days with events
The Overview clock in any of the timer looks
The Bluetooth notice for every device, with its battery, and headphones found behind audio offload drivers
Opening the notch and switching tools without the panel blur, for smoother frames
A first preview for Macs with Apple silicon and Intel
Plugins: add your own tools as sandboxed web widgets, and your own parts to the closed row with crest-notify
Crest in 11 languages, Arabic right to left; it follows Windows unless you pick one in Settings, General
A read-only Calendar from ICS links or CalDAV, with a notice before each event
A first-run setup with presets, the closed look and the shortcut
Volume and brightness in the closed notch, which can stand in for the Windows indicator
Lyrics word by word, with translation and romanisation, from more sources
With more monitors the notch can follow the pointer or sit on every monitor
A larger toolbar with a mark under the tool you are on
ARM64 builds, a SHA256SUMS file with every release and Copy diagnostics in Settings
Set the size of the closed notch, capsule and line in Settings, Display
Each reading of the closed notch sits next to its own icon, with coloured icons as an option
A currency converter at the ECB reference rates; file conversion is gone
Your profile picture in the GitHub tool, and a click on it opens your profile
The installer shows the Crest icon
Fixed the notch going blank when a timer finished
The closed notch comes as a notch, a capsule or a line, on any screen edge
A row shows cover, timer, Discord call, AI quota, title or lyrics, hardware, equalizer, clock and GitHub
Notices in the notch: recording, timer, status alerts, Windows notifications, quota, to-dos and water
Synced lyrics, an equalizer fed only by the player, and a player picker
Screenshots and screen recording with system audio and microphone
A terminal with PowerShell or Command Prompt in the notch
A launcher with pinned apps, and your GitHub activity
To-dos with due times, a water reminder and a code scratchpad
AI usage with tokens and cost from local logs, and more providers
Hardware with cores, GPUs, network, power, battery, temperatures, processes and drives
A portfolio across several brokers in one base currency, read only
Themes with an editor and a day and night switch
Rules for full screen and apps, scaling, your own shortcuts and a portable build
The interface is English only
Crest is based on L4-Notchbar 1.6.0, with its own name, updates and settings
AI usage shows the Antigravity limits instead of the retired Gemini CLI
